title: OrderShare - Data API
description: Represents a sharing entry on an Order. This object is available in API version 48.0 and later.

OrderAccessLevel.description: Level of access that the user or group has to the order. Possible values are: All—Owner. This value isn’t valid when creating, updating, or deleting records. Edit—Read/Write Read—Read Only

OrderId.description: ID of the order associated with this sharing entry. This field can't be updated. This is a relationship field.

RowCause.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
RowCause.description: Reason that this sharing entry exists. If you’re creating a sharing entry, the only permitted value is Manual. If no value is specified, the field defaults to Manual. All other RowCause values are read-only. After the sharing entry is created, this field can’t be edited.

UserOrGroupId.description: ID of the user or group that has been given access to the order. This field can't be updated. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

usage:
This object allows you to determine which users and groups can view or edit orders owned by other users. If you attempt to create a record that matches an existing record, any modified fields are updated, the system returns the existing record.
